frequency_question: How often do central bank principals elect to activate special reserve ratio tools when facing excess liquidity challenges within a designated short-term window?
membership_rule: Includes discretionary central bank announcements of incremental, secondary, or special cash reserve ratios targeting banking system liquidity. Excludes standard statutory reserve ratio adjustments made during regular monetary policy framing cycles.
window: Any multi-month operational window where liquidity management tools are actively evaluated.

cases.name: People's Bank of China RRR hike for liquidity management
Central Bank of Brazil compulsory deposit rate adjustment

provenance_note: 3 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.7x)
coverage_note: 3 named; believed roughly 5 in total across comparable emerging market jurisdictions.
known_gaps: Restricted strictly to major emerging market central banks with direct structural parallels to the subject institution.
skeleton: Observed deployment cycles of discretionary liquidity absorption instruments by major central banks over the past decade.
multiplier: 3 historical instances of targeted liquidity tool activation divided by 5 comparable systemic liquidity surge episodes yielding similar policy intent.
validity_reason: Central banking statutory toolkits and liquidity management preferences evolve slowly over multi-year regulatory horizons.
